description: For ordinals \(\alpha\le \beta\), the inherited-order tail of \(\beta\) consisting of positions at least \(\alpha\) has an order type \(\gamma\) satisfying \(\alpha+\gamma=\beta\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.OrdinalArithmetic.remainderTail_type.{u_1} (a b : Ordinal.{u_1}) (h : a ≤ b) :
  (a + Ordinal.type fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) = b
